name: Basta Core
description: Basta Core was a frigid scrub-covered planet that possessed blue vegetation. In 21 ABY Enric Pryde, Viceprex Coromun and a group of CSA troopers participated in a mission to eliminate a syndicate of insurgents and capture a cache of arms.
lead_paragraphs: Basta Core was a frigid scrub-covered planet that possessed blue vegetation. In 21 ABY Enric Pryde, Viceprex Coromun and a group of CSA troopers participated in a mission to eliminate a syndicate of insurgents and capture a cache of arms.
